name: Alex Agius Saliba - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the annual report on the activities of the European Ombudsman in 2023
part_text:
The European Parliament backs the European Ombudsman's work in 2023 and calls on the European Commission to stop delaying public access to documents. It wants the Commission to answer requests within the legal deadlines and publish more documents on its own. It also asks for stronger ethics rules, better protection of fundamental rights, and fixes to EU recruitment tests. The report is the Parliament's opinion; it does not change any law itself.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission to speed up document replies and publish more.
- **Who it affects:** The Commission, other EU bodies, and people requesting EU documents.
- **What happens next:** The Commission is expected to act; Parliament says it could take the Commission to court.
